model_name.snippet: Derm Foundation is a machine learning (ML) model that produces embeddings based on dermatology images.

Derm Foundation is an embedding tool derived from our research in applying DL to interpret images of dermatology conditions and includes our recent work that adds improvements to generalize better to new datasets.

summary.snippet: Derm Foundation is a machine learning model designed to accelerate AI development for skin image analysis for dermatology applications using pre-trained embeddings.
The model produces a 6144-dimensional embedding vector as output, which can be used for downstream tasks like classifying skin conditions and scoring severity.

keywords.snippet: Derm Foundation is a machine learning model designed to accelerate AI development for skin image analysis for dermatology applications using pre-trained embeddings.

Derm Foundation can be used for data-efficient classification tasks, including:
- Classifying clinical conditions like psoriasis, melanoma, or dermatitis

usefulness_efficacy_goal_of_metrics.snippet: Derm Foundation was evaluated for data-efficient accuracy across a range of skin-related classifications tasks.

usefulness_efficacy_result.snippet: Training a linear classifier on Derm-Foundations embeddings were substantially more performant (10-15% increase in accuracy) than doing the same for a standard BiT-M model across different proportions of training data.

usefulness_efficacy_test_type.snippet: To evaluate this approach, we trained models on a downstream task using teledermatology data. Model training involved varying dataset sizes (12.5%, 25%, 50%, 100%) to compare embedding-based linear classifiers against fine-tuning.

usefulness_efficacy_testing_data_descrip.snippet: The SFT (supervised fine-tuned) model was trained data from a limited set of countries (United States, Colombia, Australia, public images) and settings (mostly clinical).
